_comment: Target form: ONE LINE PER AXIS, 'Axis name: observation'. This mirrors the annotator's note - one clause per observed fact, nothing added to make it flow.

All three axes must appear even when the note is silent about one: the prompt says the reasoning must address each criterion. A silent axis gets a short line derived from its sub-score, with no invented specifics.
No overall verdict line, no (PAn) marker, no 'description:' header, and no score anywhere - the score is already in the row's own field.

PA example: agent_consistency is 2 and the note is silent, so line 1 is generic. scene_consistency is 1 and the note supplies the observation. interaction_realism is 0 and the note says 严重违反, so the line opens 'Severe violation.'
IA example: agent_match is 2 and silent. object_correct 1 and goal_completed 1 come from the note; 部分完成 becomes 'Partially completed.'

input.note:
背景物体一致性 存在问题：部分香蕉未被接触就出现移位变形
交互真实性 严重违反：机械手抓取香蕉时手指与香蕉严重穿模，接触反馈不符合物理规则

acceptable_output.reasoning:
Agent integrity: The robotic arm and gripper stay structurally complete and consistent, with no melting, fused fingers or warping.
Scene & object consistency: Several bananas shift position and deform without being touched, so their movement has no visible cause.
Interaction realism: Severe violation. The gripper's fingers pass straight through the banana during the grasp, and the contact feedback does not follow physical rules.

input.note:
目标物正确 存在问题：仅操作了指定的透明气泡袋，未操作要求的白色长方形产品盒
目标完成度 部分完成：仅将透明气泡袋放入纸箱，未放入白色长方形产品盒，未完全达成打包目标

acceptable_output.reasoning:
Agent match: The manipulation is carried out by the gripper shown in the initial frame, with no other agent involved.
Object correctness: Only the clear bubble wrap pouch is handled; the white rectangular product box the instruction also names is never picked up.
Goal completion: Partially completed. The bubble wrap pouch is placed into the cardboard box, but the product box is left where it started.
